parole.significato: date (the fruit of the date palm, Phoenix dactylifera)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Italian, more specifically from a Northern Italian dialect. Compare Venetan dàtolo (“date”), from Medieval Latin datalus, datilis, from Ancient Greek δάκτυλος (dáktulos, “finger, date”), possibly from a Semitic source.

parole.significato: galley (a ship propelled primarily by oars)
parole.testo: From an Italian dialect, compare Venetan galia, from Medieval Latin galea, from Byzantine Greek γάλεα (gálea, “galley”), of unknown origin.
